evidence_policy: One tested decision inconsistency, four associated/contextual candidates; not five proven bot bugs
priority_formula: surrogate coverage × subjective fixability × subjective transfer / hours including fuel risk
priority_limits: Planning sensitivity score, not expected win-rate gain. Coverage labels overlap; M1 uses its later associated swing window, M3/M5 share broad camp-income coverage, not an identified causal ceiling. Effort and probabilities are judgments, not measurements. Scores must not be added or read as percentages of recoverable wins.

mistakes.code_location: bots/live-69/src/bot.cpp: play_turn winning-bag recall condition around7005; tribute_if_needed eligibility around4535, disable timer around4639
mistakes.recommended_next_step: Require !w.no_bank && round>=tribute_off_until before the win-only cancellation; preserve the existing dangerous-channel cancellation branch. Recommendation only.
